lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₂Ti₁₀V₄O₂₄ (MgTi₅VO₁₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 40 atoms per unit cell across 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ti centers with six O neighbors, while Mg and V each have eight O neighbors, and O centers coordinate to mixtures of Mg, Ti, and V. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ti 6-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Ti polyhedra.
